name: kb_fire_mage
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's fire raid list: Pyroblast on a Hot Streak stack, Fire Blast on cooldown, Scorch until Fire Vulnerability is at five stacks on a long-lived target, Fireball as the filler, and the AoE list (Flamestrike rank 6 then rank 5, Blast Wave, Arcane Explosion). The opener order, the fireball counting between Fire Blasts, the Ignite management and the Flarecore set are not conditions (kb.unexpressed).

rows.text: Opener: Fire Blast -> Scorch x3 -> Fireball -> Fire Blast (Fire Blast while a Fireball is in flight banks a Fire Vulnerability stack) | pull
Pyroblast | 5 Hot Streak stacks (4 only if the boss is about to die)
rows.unexpressed: the five-stack count is not a condition (self stacks are not read); "the boss is about to die" is not a condition

rows.text: Fire Blast | off cooldown: after 2 Fireballs with no haste, after a 3rd Fireball with small haste
rows.unexpressed: the fireball count between two blasts (2, or 3 with haste) is not a condition

rows.text: Scorch | Fire Vulnerability below 5 stacks AND target lives > ~1 min; never extra Scorches to "extend" Ignite

entries.note: mob_hp_above 70 stands in for "target lives > ~1 min", as the shipped fire_mage file does; the "never extend Ignite" rule is a note, not an entry.
Moved after the AoE entries: the filler has no cooldown, so as a rule it would starve every entry the KB lists after it.

rows.text: Let a weak (partially resisted) Ignite drop and rebuild; signal other Fire mages via /bw extra magetools ignitedroptrigger | weak Ignite rolling
rows.unexpressed: the Ignite's strength is not a condition; macro/addon (Nampower etc.)

rows.text: Rank-1 Arcane Explosion (pre-proc trinkets, low threat)
rows.unexpressed: pre-pull/opener outside the brain's fight; consumable or item (combat_consumables owns items)

rows.text: Flamestrike rank 6 -> Flamestrike rank 5 (two DoTs tick)

entries.note: The rank-6 cast; the rank-5 one of the KB's pair is not an entry (see kb.unexpressed).

rows.unexpressed: the rank-5 Flamestrike that makes the second DoT tick needs a cast-alternation condition the format does not have; "mobs stay grouped and alive" is not a condition

entries.note: mob_distance_max 10 is Arcane Explosion's own radius.

rows.unexpressed: an item set bonus is not a condition (combat_consumables owns items)

rows.text: Combustion | after Fire Vulnerability is stacked, into Fireball/Pyroblast

entries.note: mob_aura stands in for "stacked": the stack count of Fire Vulnerability is not read.

rows.text: Mind Quickening Gem | save for chosen fights (Medivh, Faerlina, Heigan); best on short fights given its ~5 min cooldown, or pre-summon and swap to it right before the pull for a longer fight
